# Independent review — Euler half-plane return

- **Reviewed candidate SHA-256:** `68d94cba49b7c5cfc49609f92ebc376f7238164dc8c0fbfb93ec6954b0685cf7`

**VERDICT: ACCEPT_UNIFORM_RAW_MELLIN_HALFPLANE_STABILITY_ONLY.**

The complete-source Mellin calculation S2 is valid on `Re s>3/2`; the Euler product and absolutely convergent reciprocal series give the stated all-height lower bound there. S4 correctly identifies failure of multiplicativity of the normalized finite coefficients without overextending it to arbitrary factorizations.

For every `epsilon>0`, S6 and S7 provide the needed dominated-convergence errors at `b=3/2+epsilon`. In particular the delta term is retained and uniformly dominated. S8 is the exact normalized comparison, and S9 supplies a positive lower bound independent of imaginary height. The resulting zero-free statement for every sufficiently large `N` on `Re s>=3/2+epsilon` follows by the displayed triangle inequality.

This is the classical Euler-product/summability half-plane translated to the raw finite approximants. It is compatible with the accepted escaping zeros to its left and gives no result in `5/4<Re s<=3/2`, no terminal-V sign, and no RH progress by itself.
parent_check: Full square-rate Mellin integral with absolute Fubini domain; exact coprime coefficient defect; uniform domination of all harmonic corrections; all-height normalized comparison; reciprocal Euler-series modulus.
statement: For every epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that all N>=N_epsilon have raw M_N(s)!=0 for every Re(s)>=3/2+epsilon, with no bound on imaginary height.
